title: Mindcop
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#773, 2026-10-29), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 after 26 minutes: a graphics driver check dialog shows at start and can be ignored, the Epic copy. Not verified by the maintainer. h6c287gskb-collab (highball-db#1065, 2026-11-07), Apple M1, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 5 of 5 after 30 minutes: everything worked out of the box. The first launch crashed and Highball offered another way, which worked, the copy isn't stated.
notes: Reported playable on an M1 with D3DMetal over 26 minutes (Epic), and perfect on an M1 over 30 minutes with DXVK after the first launch crashed and Highball offered another mode (highball-db#1065).
